structured.answer: I'd lean to Harel's "כספי (שקלי)" track: 0% shares, 0% foreign currency, a name I know, about 4.25% a year over 3 years, and a 0.57% fee. But I'm not sure, and I won't sign anything before asking my son or the bank.

Many columns and coloured circles; I had to work out which column meant shares and which meant safe
I wanted the government bond tracks but didn't see where they are in the list
Tired; the numbers were running together, so I stopped

Company name Harel (and Meitav, Analyst for comparison)
Management fee '0.57%' from savings, '0%' from deposits
